# FDG5036

> DO use the name `Item` for indexed properties unless there is an obviously better name (e.g., see the `Chars` property on `System.String`).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2.1 Indexed Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate: whether another name is obviously better (Chars on String) is a matter of judgment. C# names an indexer Item unless IndexerNameAttribute names it otherwise.

## From the book

In C#, indexers are by default named `Item`. The `IndexerNameAttribute` can be used to customize this name.

```csharp
public sealed class String {
 [System.Runtime.CompilerServices.IndexerNameAttribute("Chars")]
 public char this[int index] {
   get { ... }
 }
 ...
}
```
